name: 911 SSPO Invoicing Prep
description: Splits a pricing sheet into one workbook per Batch + Nest ('BATCH NEST Pricing Back Up.xlsx', each in its own 'BATCH NEST Invoicing Docs' folder) with an Invoice Supplement tab (PO/Line from the Working Forecast List), plus a top-level 'D911 Workorder Close Outs' sheet (cols A-Machine, Scheduling Group set to Closed).
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the SSPO pricing workbook ready - you pick the file when the app opens.
Keep the Working Forecast List synced; the app pulls each nest's PO and PO Line from it.
how_it_works: Pick the pricing workbook. The app splits it into one workbook per Batch + Nest.
Each split gets a Pricing Back Up tab (with a total-per-work-order sum) and an ASA Invoice Supplement tab.
It reads the PO / PO Line from a temp copy of the forecast (never the live file) and links prices through, so a corrected price flows to the grand total.
output: One 'BATCH NEST Pricing Back Up.xlsx' per nest, each in its own 'BATCH NEST Invoicing Docs' subfolder.
A top-level 'D911 Workorder Close Outs {date}.xlsx' with every row's Scheduling Group set to Closed.
The output folder opens in Explorer when it's done.
